initial.title: the Magician
initial.doom_desc:
A malevolent fate is gathering around you. If your Doom reaches 100%, you will be afflicted by a random bane and your Doom will reset to 0. Banes have diverse negative effects that can significantly endanger your character for an extended period of time.

Both Doom and Banes are only cured by gaining experience, though Banes typically last much longer.

You are being constricted by an enemy. Your evasion is impaired, and you will take damage over time. You are unable to move away from the enemy, although you can struggle to escape by attempting to do so, and will become increasingly more likely to succeed and break the constriction when doing so multiple times.
